title: Tech Innovation Summit 2026
description: A full-day summit featuring talks from industry leaders on AI, blockchain, and the future of technology in education.

title: Art Exhibition: Beyond Canvas
description: Explore contemporary art pieces created by students and local artists. Interactive installations and live painting sessions.

title: Basketball Championship Finals
description: Watch the top two university teams compete for the championship trophy. Food stalls and half-time entertainment included.

title: Annual Career Fair 2026
description: Connect with top employers and explore internship and job opportunities. Bring your resume and dress professionally.

title: Music Festival: Sounds of Campus
description: An evening of live music featuring student bands and a special guest DJ. Food trucks and glow sticks available.

title: Wellness & Yoga Workshop
description: Start your semester right with guided yoga and mindfulness sessions. Mats and refreshments provided.

title: AI & Machine Learning Workshop
description: Hands-on workshop covering Python, TensorFlow, and practical ML applications. Laptops required.

title: Debate Championship 2026
description: Watch top debaters from across the region compete. Audience voting for the People's Choice award.

title: Film Screening Night
description: A curated selection of short films by student filmmakers followed by a Q&A panel with the directors.
